source: hand-authored fallback — standard Indian general-insurance document lists

claim_types.label: Fire & Allied Perils
claim_types.description: Damage to insured property or stock by fire, lightning, explosion, riot, strike, malicious damage, storm, cyclone, flood or inundation.

claim_types.label: Burglary & Theft
claim_types.description: Loss of property by theft, or by burglary or housebreaking involving forcible and violent entry to or exit from the premises.

claim_types.label: Motor Own Damage
claim_types.description: Accidental damage to, or theft of, an insured motor vehicle including cars, bikes and commercial vehicles.

claim_types.label: Machinery Breakdown
claim_types.description: Sudden and unforeseen internal mechanical or electrical breakdown of plant and machinery, not caused by an external peril.

claim_types.label: Electronic Equipment
claim_types.description: Damage to computers, servers, medical or other electronic equipment by any cause not otherwise excluded.

claim_types.label: Personal Accident & Medical
claim_types.description: Bodily injury, disablement or medical treatment arising from an accident.

rules.label: Policy schedule
rules.help_text: The page your insurer issued showing your policy number and the period of insurance.

rules.label: Government photo ID
rules.help_text: Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence or Passport. A masked Aadhaar is fine.

rules.label: Photographs of the damage
rules.help_text: Clear photographs of the damaged property taken at the location of the loss.

rules.label: Cancelled cheque or bank passbook
rules.help_text: Needed to settle the claim directly to your account. The name, account number and IFSC must be legible.

rules.label: Signed claim form
rules.help_text: The insurer's claim form, completed and signed. We prepare a draft for you — you only need to sign and upload it.

rules.label: Fire brigade report
rules.help_text: The report issued by the fire service that attended the incident.

rules.label: Police FIR (riot, strike or malicious damage only)
rules.help_text: Required only where the loss arose from riot, strike or malicious damage.

rules.label: Stock statement or purchase invoices
rules.help_text: Your stock register, or the purchase invoices covering the damaged stock.

rules.label: Repair or reinstatement estimate
rules.help_text: A written estimate from a contractor or supplier for repairing or replacing the damaged property.

rules.label: Letter of subrogation
rules.help_text: Signed on your company letterhead. Your insurer will provide the template.

rules.label: Police FIR or station diary entry
rules.help_text: Registered at the police station covering the location of the loss. Lodge it as soon as possible after discovering the loss.

rules.label: Final police report or non-traceable certificate
rules.help_text: Issued by the police once the investigation closes. Send it when you receive it — it is not needed to start the claim.

rules.label: Purchase invoices for the stolen items
rules.help_text: Original purchase invoices establishing ownership and value of the items taken.

rules.label: Vehicle registration certificate (RC)
rules.help_text: The RC book or card for the insured vehicle.

rules.label: Driving licence of the person driving
rules.help_text: The licence of whoever was driving at the time of the accident — not necessarily the policyholder.

rules.label: Garage repair estimate
rules.help_text: A written estimate from the repairing garage or workshop.

rules.label: Police FIR (theft or third-party injury only)
rules.help_text: Required where the vehicle was stolen, or where a third party was injured or their property damaged.

rules.label: Final repair bill and payment receipt
rules.help_text: Send these once the repair is complete — they are not needed to start the claim.

rules.label: Repair estimate for the machinery
rules.help_text: A written estimate from the repairer or the equipment manufacturer.

rules.label: Technician or manufacturer breakdown report
rules.help_text: A written account from the engineer who examined the machine, stating what failed and why.

rules.label: Purchase invoice for the machine
rules.help_text: Establishes the age and original value of the machinery.

rules.label: Purchase invoice for the equipment
rules.help_text: Establishes ownership, age and value of the damaged equipment.

rules.label: Repair estimate or non-repairable certificate
rules.help_text: From an authorised service centre. If the equipment cannot be repaired, their written confirmation of that.

rules.label: Medical certificate
rules.help_text: From the treating doctor, stating the nature of the injury and the treatment given.

rules.label: Hospital bills and discharge summary
rules.help_text: Itemised bills together with the discharge summary from the hospital.
